[LFAC.9.1] **A slot named `ts` is a `Time`.** A schema may declare a slot named
`ts` and need not. If it does, the slot's type must be `Time`, not nullable. The
compiler must refuse a `ts` slot of any other type, `Time?` included, with
`DS_VALIDATE_TS_NOT_TIME`.

A construct that needs `ts` requires it of the schemas it reads: every adapter
schema declares it ([LADP.4.2.1]), and so does every schema in a `then` sequence,
the anchor `latest` pins among them ([LTHE.4.5]). Any other schema may declare it,
and there it is the slot this clause describes and nothing more.

**`ts` is the engine's slot, outside identity and outside the no-op test.** It
carries no `key` or `mutable` marker on any schema; on a `logical` schema it is
the one slot [LFAC.1.7.4]'s require-all does not reach, and the compiler must
refuse a marker on it with `DS_VALIDATE_TS_MARKED`. It takes no part in the
schema's identity key ([LFAC.1.7]) and no part in the no-op comparison
([LFAC.2.5.1]): a reassertion that differs from the live fact only in `ts` is
a no-op, and the live fact keeps the `ts` it was given when it entered
([LFAC.9.2]). In the artefact, on a `logical` schema, it carries the identity role
`ENGINE` ([RDSC.5.5.7]). Only a `logical` schema has a no-op test or an identity
key; on any other schema `ts` is a slot like the rest wherever two facts are
compared ([RFCS.23.7]), since it is what tells two events of one schema apart.

alloy.name: iret_19_1__ts_outside_key_and_payload
alloy.note: ts takes no part in the identity key and no part in the payload the no-op test compares, on every schema. Bounded: six slots, six schemas. The comparison of two facts of a schema that is not `logical`, where the clause has `ts` a slot like the rest ([RFCS.23.7]), is not this model's.

alloy.name: lfac_9_1__one_ts_per_schema
alloy.note: A schema declares ts at most once. That it is a Time, and the refusals DS_VALIDATE_TS_NOT_TIME and DS_VALIDATE_TS_MARKED, are the validator's, not modelled.

alloy.name: lfac_9_1__ts_unmarked
alloy.note: ts carries no key or mutable marker on any schema: ENGINE on a logical schema, UNSPECIFIED elsewhere. Bounded: six slots, six schemas.
